result.summary:
P22 is done on its own files: the 5 red cases are green in every run since the restart except one case during a temporary edit by P23 (withdrawn since). The P22 guard batch still shows 2 reds on the current tree; both come from P23's in-progress edits, not from P22 (details in openIssues).

**What the previous agent's draft already fixed (kept as is, re-read and verified):**
- **law.interpelle-joueur (board while escorting):** `withDetainee(a)` in `ops-arrest.ts`, used in `special.ts startEmbark` and `system.ts drive`. An agent in charge of a detainee is not seated by an embark order; he boards after the handover.
- **nasse-sortie-filtree seeds 23 and 5:** the called van was declared "stalled" after 12 s because its first remaining-route reading was 0. `findHandover` now starts `vanBest` at Infinity and `arrest-service.remaining` falls back to straight-line distance until the autopilot has a route. All 9 seeds now end with 4 of 4 culprits in custody and 0 leaks.
- **bravm.ordres-joueur T5:** after the offender has fled once and stopped, the pair approaches at a walk inside 26 m instead of running, which the crowd reads as a charge. Measured: pair on him at t+40 s, arrested at t+57.5 s.
- **ui-command.envoi-fiche nasse:** the test now forces a scene refresh at each step. The loop bound, exit condition and assertions are unchanged, so nothing is weakened. I measured that without it the scene refreshes on the wall clock (about every 5 iterations) and the loop missed the one step where two exits were held.

**What I added this session:**
- **`pushThrough` in `transfer/system.ts`:** a cellular van that left for the station without two-tone and is held 45 s within 8 m by a stopped vehicle gets its trip re-issued once in urgency and says « Retenu par des véhicules à l'arrêt, je passe au deux-tons ». Found while diagnosing transfer.cellulaire « 30 minutes » under P23's temporary `parkBrake`: the full CELLULAIRE 1 stayed 15 minutes behind stopped civil cars, in the player's sight, and 0 detainees were delivered. On the current tree the 30-minute scenario delivers 16 detainees to the station, 4 aboard.
- **New test** in `transfer.cellulaire.test.ts`: urgent at t+46 s, two-tone at t+58 s, announced at t+76 s, first blocking car cleared at t+68 s.

`tsc` is clean. No P22 probe file is left.

Side effect: the convoy also says its usual « Embarquez, départ en colonne » on the radio.

Nasse seeds 23 and 5: the plan offered two designs (van to 20 m behind the line, or free the pair sooner). Neither was needed. The van was already sent to that rendezvous; a false stall detection stopped it at 160 m. Only that detection was fixed (previous agent's change, kept).

T5: the walking approach after a flight (`CHASE_FLEE`, `CHASE_SLOW`, `CHASE_CALM` and `ArrestExtra.fled` in `ops-arrest.ts`) is a mechanism not in the plan text (previous agent's draft, kept after verification).

`tests/unit/ui-command.envoi-fiche.test.ts`: `core.maps.scene.invalidate()` added before `ensureFresh()` inside the wait loop (previous agent's change, kept). No assertion, bound or exit condition was changed.
Edits outside the P22 file list, both small and logged in `coordination-etape5.md` by the previous agent: `special.ts startEmbark` (one guard and one import) and `system.ts drive` (one condition).

The new transfer test asserts the switch to urgency, the two-tone, the radio line and the first blocking car cleared. It does not assert that the van gets through the wall of driverless hand-braked cars: in that artificial case the convoy and engins rules (P23's files) clear cars slowly, and one probe run lost urgency again at t+231 s. The full trip in real traffic is covered by the existing « 30 minutes » test, where `pushThrough` fires for both vans and delivered ≥ 8 holds.
Bisecting priority 1 with a scratch copy was not redone: the previous agent's bisect is recorded in the coordination file and the case is green in all seven runs.
openIssues: Two cases of the P22 guard batch are red on the current tree: `playtest.commissariats` « retour sous les yeux du joueur — 9e : chaque véhicule se gare lui-même dans les places » (expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal []) and `session.cellulaires` « journée de service : les fourgons cellulaires partent avec la colonne … » (point de remise null). Both were green three times between 23:32 and 23:52 and are red since P23's edits of 23:58–00:32 (`autopilot.ts`, `autopilot-state.ts`, `pathfind.ts`, `contracts.ts`, `bravm.ts`, `journee.ts`), with and without `pushThrough`. P23 was still editing when I stopped; re-run the P22 guard batch once P23 is finished.

`police.convoi-ordre-joueur` « journée de service du commandant … tout le monde à pied » (P23's batch) was red at 00:18–00:25 and green at 23:45–23:52. It does not load the transfer module and the `withDetainee` guards were already in at 23:45, so I attribute it to P23's later edits; I did not verify further.

`ui-command.envoi-fiche` nasse stays fragile against any change in how vehicles sit at Concorde. It went red under P20's idle handbrake hold (21:29–22:21) and again under P23's `parkBrake` (23:42–23:56), and is green without them. In my probe « Encercler (nasse) » on the marching cortège gave a street to each two-agent BRAV-M pair as well as to the sections, the crowd's exits moved with its head, and at most 1–2 exits were held, briefly. If a handbrake hold comes back, this case will flip again; the cause is in `ui/command` unit selection and the moving-crowd exits, outside P22's files.

`convoy.ts arrive()` (P23's file, not edited): the direct start without `boardFirst` calls `ap.convoy(...)` without `...this.pace(c)`, so a column started that way never drives with `urgence:true` at the autopilot level. Reported in the coordination file.

In the « 30 minutes » scenario on the current tree both departing vans are held more than 45 s by stopped civil cars and need `pushThrough` (radio at 705 s and 1402 s). The traffic stops for the player standing on the roadway beside the vans, then the motorists pull over across the lane. The point de remise sits on a street open to traffic; closing or thinning traffic there would be the deeper fix and was not attempted.

`engins.ts backoffStep` (P23's file) can resume a vehicle without urgency after backing off; this is already in P21's open issues. In the wall-of-cars probe the van lost its urgency again at t+231 s; `pushThrough` fires only once per trip by design.
P23's probe files (`tests/unit/zz-p23-*.test.ts`) are in the tree; they are not mine and I left them.
No browser scenario was run for the new radio line or the two-tone; headless tests only.

result.summary:
P23 is done as specified: the 6 red cases are green three times in a row, `playtest.colonnes-roles` is 42/42 in both modes each time, the guard batch has no red, and tsc is clean. One caveat on « Centaure : jamais seul » is spelled out below and in openIssues.

**What now exists**

- **Second Centaure (priority 1).** A follower that is taken in charge while it rolls driverless down a slope (0.5–1.5 m/s) is now treated as a parked follower and held with its brake. Before, the autopilot took the roll for a departure, so the second Centaure drove up crookedly against the player's engine and lost it at the start. It now waits at its place and starts within 1 s of the player's departure (17 m behind at the end of the test, limit 40). No physics change, no handbrake.
- **BRAV-M 9e → Bastille and the chief's moto (priorities 2 and 3).** I kept the previous agent's draft, which made these green:
  - the player's BRAV-M is placed on the road ahead of the company at a shared base;
  - the company only lines up once the player's motos have left (45 s at most);
  - the day is not « sur place » while the chief is still riding to rejoin.
- **Player left behind in traffic (new).** On a solo BRAV-M day, the day is no longer declared « sur place » while the player rides behind an AI pilot more than 200 m from the point (at most 420 s after the head arrives). Before, he could be declared arrived 1 400 m away.
- **Chief at République (priority 4).** Two causes fixed:
  - The slow/fast toggle no longer relaunches the column while the head is stopped waiting for stragglers. It was restarting 11 s into a 40 s regroup, with two motos 150 m behind.
  - A moto stopped at the mouth of a one-way street, 2 m from the avenue it had just left, no longer goes round the block (623 m instead of 99 m). New optional path option `tightTurns`, set for two-wheelers only: within 8 m of a junction, the hairpin surcharge is judged on the vehicle's real heading. Spread in the test is now 101 m (was 376, limit 250).
- **New test** `tests/unit/world-query.itineraire-deux-roues.test.ts` (2 real-map cases: 623 m without the option, 99 m with it; identical routes away from a junction).

**Tried and withdrawn after measuring**

- Handbrake at spawn (`units.ts parkBrake`, the previous agent's unfinished approach): it made Centaure green but flipped Concorde tests tuned on the rolling (see deviations).
- Removing the hairpin surcharge entirely for motos: flipped two guard tests.
- Sending far stragglers with sirens: flipped `commandant-mission-colonne` step (d).
- Two other autopilot variants that did not help.

No assertion was weakened and no existing test file is changed by this package. All probe files (`tests/unit/zz-p23-*`) are deleted.

**Final code, the 6 red cases plus roles, three runs**

- Run 1 was on the code before two last touch-ups (`lagAt` reset in `arrived()`, a comment moved in setup.ts): the 4 red files → 18 passed, 0 failed; roles default 42/42 inside the guard batch below; roles strict 42/42.

**Guard batch**
- On the code before those two touch-ups: the plan's batch plus `world-query.`, `playtest.bravm-passager`, `integration.colonnes-bravm`, `session.bravm-concorde`, `police-command.unites-speciales`, `playtest.apparition-roles`, `playtest.colonnes-roles` → 74 files, 383 passed, 0 failed, 7 skipped.
- On the exact final code: the plan's batch plus `playtest.commissariats`, `session.cellulaires`, `transfer.`, `ui-command.envoi-fiche`, `law.interpelle-joueur`, `integration.nasse`, `session.depart-base`, `integration.colonne-`, `integration.suivre-colonne`, `integration.fin-de-colonne` → 83 files, 398 passed, 0 failed, 8 skipped.

**Type check**

**Intermediate measurements behind the withdrawals**
- Handbrake at spawn, all vehicles: roles default 42/42, strict 41/42 (République commissaire, 4/6 vans).
- Handbrake at spawn, slopes only: roles 42/42 in both modes and Centaure green, but guard batch 241 passed, 2 failed (`police.convoi-ordre-joueur` « section assise » 13 ≥ 15; `commandant-compagnie-depart` Concorde 21). P22 reported two more reds under it.
- No hairpin surcharge at all for motos: 6/6 red cases green, but guard batch 337 passed, 2 failed (`police.convoi-ordre-joueur` « journée de service du commandant »; `commandant-mission-colonne` step (d)).
- Final junction-only rule alone: `colonne-ia` « bravm 9e » and `bravm-passager` « 9e → Bastille seed 5 » red (player 1 200–1 400 m from the point at « sur place »); green once the day waits for the lagging player.
- Urgent stragglers: `commandant-mission-colonne` (d) 199 → 182 → 161 m (red); without, 175 → 97 m (green).

**Not run:** the whole suite, any browser scenario, the `PLAYTEST_COLONNE=1` matrix. The guard batch was run twice, not three times (10–14 min each on the shared machine).
deviations: Centaure priority 1: I used neither option the plan names (idle handbrake hold with a drone-team boarding fix, or the `follow.ts mayFollow` guard). The handbrake at spawn was measured and withdrawn: it keeps the VL, water cannon and Centaures in place at Concorde and flips tests tuned on their rolling (`police.convoi-ordre-joueur` « section assise », `commandant-compagnie-depart` Concorde 21, and for P22 `ui-command.envoi-fiche` nasse and `transfer.cellulaire` 30 min). The fix is in `autopilot.ts follow()`: a follower rolling driverless at 0.5–1.5 m/s when taken in charge starts held.

I edited two files outside the P23 list, both small and logged in coordination-etape5.md: `src/world/query/pathfind.ts` (about 15 lines: the option, an 8 m constant, the smaller of two hairpin surcharges at the first node) and `src/core/contracts.ts` (one optional field `tightTurns` on `PathStartOptions`). Callers that do not pass the option are unaffected; only autopilot.ts passes it, for two-wheelers.

New behaviour not written in the plan: on a solo BRAV-M service day, « sur place » waits up to 420 s for a player riding behind an AI pilot more than 200 m from the point (`journee.ts`, constants LAG_NEAR and LAG_WAIT). Reason: `colonne-ia` « bravm 9e » and `bravm-passager` seed 5 expect the player with his unit at arrival; plan §4.1.6 says he is never left alone.

Kept from the previous agent's draft without rewriting, because the tests they serve are green and the guard batch is clean: `setup.ts aheadOfForces` and service-day cellular vans placed on the nearest road outside the unit block; `journee.ts holdsOwnColumn`, `thinkLateOthers`, REJOIN_RIDE_MAX; `follow.ts` foot path to the seat after a 2 s stall and immediate release of a seat in a van that filled up. I only moved one misplaced comment in setup.ts.
The previous agent's `units.ts parkBrake` (found as an empty stub) is removed; units.ts is back to its staged content.

Withdrawn after measurement: removing the hairpin surcharge entirely for motos (flipped two guard tests); `urgence` for far stragglers in `bravm.ts sendStragglers` (flipped `commandant-mission-colonne` (d)); a 'follower that left its place is no longer held' rule in holdBehind (did not help the Centaure); a widened radio wait in `integration.journee.chef-bravm` (not needed with the final code, the file is unchanged).

The plan asks for the guard batch three times at the end; it was run twice (once on the exact final code, once just before two trivial touch-ups). The 6 red cases and both roles modes were run three times.

No dedicated unit test was written for the rolling-follower hold or for the regroup fix; they are covered by `integration.suivre` « Centaure : jamais seul » and `playtest.bravm-passager` « chef, République seed 21 ».
openIssues: « Centaure : jamais seul » is green, but the test's blind drive still ends on the Concorde balustrade near (81.5, 91.2) after about 22 m, as in the published game. What is new is that the second Centaure starts within 1 s and is manoeuvring to follow when the leader stops (17 m). A long follow behind a Centaure that keeps driving is not covered by any test: in my no-fix trace the second Centaure was held until the leader was 42 m away, then waited 5 s behind its own foot escort, and started 17 s late.

Idle crewed police vehicles still roll down the Concorde slope from t = 0 (VL 7 m, water cannon 8.5 m, Centaure 13 m in 45 s), as in the published game. A handbrake at spawn stops it but needs the whole suite re-tuned. With it on, three shield bearers stay wedged at about (80.5, 71) for 50 s while boarding in `police.convoi-ordre-joueur` « section assise » (seed 21); the boarding walk in `sim/police/system.ts` is the weak point.

The player's own vehicle also rolls when he sits at the wheel without input on that slope (12–21 m backwards in 45 s in the Centaure test). Not changed: `player-vehicle.ts` sets the handbrake from the key only.

Autopilot creep defect not fixed: an urgent police moto behind queued civil cars alternates `attente/vehicule` and `en_route` at 0.1–0.4 m/s, so `blockedFor` restarts and no overtaking happens. Seen for 170 s near (1944–1949, −562) in 9e → Bastille. The day now waits for the player, which hides the effect in the tests, but his moto can still spend minutes in a queue.

Same family: a moto at full throttle against the flank of a stopped car moves at 0.2 m/s and is never seen as stuck (the stall test needs speed under 0.12 m/s). Seen near (3496, −71) before the route fix; I designed a fix but did not implement it.

After arrival, far stragglers are still sent to the head without sirens (`bravm.ts sendStragglers`); `rejoin()` relaunches stopped ones with urgency beyond 300 m. Making the first send urgent flips `commandant-mission-colonne` (d).

`playtest.commandant-mission-colonne` step (d) remains sensitive to any change in BRAV-M timing (two of my withdrawn variants flipped it). It is green on the final code; nothing was done to make it robust (not asked in P23).

A column of parked vans can deadlock in a ring at departure, and the first van then spends 40–50 s in a U-turn that fails every 0.3–0.8 s (République, strict roles, commissaire, vans #38/#46, seen only under the withdrawn handbrake). The existing unjam resolves it after about 60 s.

The new 420 s wait applies only when the player is a passenger behind an AI police pilot on a `moto_bravm`; a player riding his own moto far behind is still declared « sur place » when the head arrives, as before.

Not checked in a browser: the « Ma mission » card and HUD while the day waits for a lagging player (the stage stays `route`, so the card should keep showing the route). Worth one look in the integration playtest.

P22 noted in the coordination file that `convoy.ts arrive()` without `boardFirst` calls `ap.convoy(...)` without the pace options, so a direct start never drives with `urgence: true`. I did not look into it.
